parameters.query:
WITH existing_checkout AS (
    SELECT ch.*
    FROM checkout_sessions ch
    JOIN customers c ON c.id = ch.customer_id
    WHERE c.telegram_id = $1::BIGINT
      AND ch.status = 'awaiting_confirmation'
      AND ch.expires_at > NOW()
    LIMIT 1
),
valid_product AS (
    SELECT id, price, stock
    FROM products
    WHERE id = $2::BIGINT
      AND is_active = TRUE
      AND stock >= $3::INTEGER
),
valid_customer AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM customers
    WHERE telegram_id = $1::BIGINT
),
new_checkout AS (
    INSERT INTO checkout_sessions (
        customer_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        delivery_address
    )
    SELECT
        c.id,
        p.id,
        $3::INTEGER,
        $4::TEXT
    FROM valid_customer c
    CROSS JOIN valid_product p
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM existing_checkout
    )
    RETURNING *
),
selected_checkout AS (
    SELECT * FROM existing_checkout
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM new_checkout
)
SELECT
    ch.id AS checkout_id,
    ch.status,
    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM new_checkout n
            WHERE n.id = ch.id
        )
        THEN 'new_checkout'
        ELSE 'existing_checkout'
    END AS checkout_result,
    ch.quantity,
    ch.delivery_address,
    ch.expires_at,
    p.name AS product_name,
    p.price AS unit_price,
    p.price * ch.quantity AS total_amount
FROM selected_checkout ch
JOIN products p ON p.id = ch.product_id;

UPDATE checkout_sessions
SET status = 'expired'
WHERE customer_id = (
    SELECT id
    FROM customers
    WHERE telegram_id = $1::BIGINT
)
AND status = 'awaiting_confirmation'
AND expires_at <= NOW()
RETURNING id;
